data.name: Abra
data.gender_notes: Abra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'abr' (to be a father of), Abra is a name for a woman who is the mother of numerous offspring. In Islamic history, Abra is mentioned as the wife of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), the matriarch of the Hebrew people. The name Abra carries the meaning “Father of a great multitude” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abra usually hope their child will grow to embody father of a great multitude and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes motherhood, nurturing, and the abundance of blessings.
data.etymology: Abra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of a great multitude.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abra total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
